expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Unregisters and destroys this component. @param bPromoteChildren Reattaches scene-component children to this component's parent when true. Enables or disables component ticking while editing. Marks whether the component is excluded from non-editor builds and cooked data. Marks whether this component exists only for editor visualization. Creates and returns a component whose script result specializes to ComponentClass. @param WithName Optional name for the new component. Runtime pattern: creates each spawnable reflected component subtype. Classes marked NotAngelscriptSpawnable do not receive this declaration.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both.
inputs: Seeded receiver state, the exact mutation arguments, repeated-call behavior, and cleanup or restoration inputs where the operation owns resources.
